deals.rewards: Wetzel's Rewards (US terms): free, 18+. Sign-up gives 25 bonus points and a BOGO Original or Sinful Cinnamon. 1 point per dollar before tax, 50 points = $5 reward, rewards expire after 90 days, birthday reward, monthly member offers. Third-party delivery orders earn no points. Canadian loyalty login: wetzels.myloyaltyhub.com; Canadian terms unconfirmed.
deals.other: No Canadian or mall-specific promos found. National Pretzel Day is April 26 (worth a spring campaign).

platterly_fit.angle: Mall kiosk with heavy foot traffic and office towers nearby: QR on a counter or kiosk screen turns walk-by shoppers into leads; Party Packs and Bitz trays are the corporate upsell.
platterly_fit.wheel_draft: wp-dip 30, wp-off 20, wp-lemon 15, wp-bogo 15, wp-bitz 15, wp-party 5 (supabase/seed.sql). Owner approves prizes and food cost.
